title: Stat collect
description: Atom: observe panel (read-only), OCR wave / coins / diamonds, toggle currency HUD for rates, write a CSV row. Start selected runs once now; interval pool uses every 30s when enabled.
notes: CSV: runs/stat_collect.csv. Currency toggle only touches the top HUD cluster (nx≈0.15, ny≈0.09), not Attack/Defense/Utility. Keep humanize_upgrade_loop disabled.

actions.description: Read-only status: is the upgrade panel open, and which tab? (No tab clicks.)

actions.message: stat collect: panel_open={panel_open} tab={upgrade_tab} — leaving it as-is
actions.description: Confirm we will not touch the upgrade footer.
Read coin balance (balances mode; typed contract).
Flip top currency HUD to /min rates (does not touch upgrade tabs).
Let the HUD settle after the toggle.
Read coins per minute (rate contract; abstain on /min→m junk).
Flip currency HUD back to balances.
Confirm upgrade panel is still in the same open/closed state after HUD toggles.

actions.message: stat row wave={wave_number} coins={coins} cpm={coins_per_min} cash/min={cash_per_min} diamonds={diamonds} panel={upgrade_tab}
actions.description: Echo the row to the Automations console.
Append datetime, run, wave, coins, coins/min, cash/min, diamonds, panel status to runs/stat_collect.csv.
